Recharger la page : plus aucun avertisse: Reload the page: no more mixed content warnings in the console.
La page référence une ressource qui répo: The page references a resource that responds with a redirect. Each image, script or stylesheet called this way costs one more round trip before displaying — on a page that has several, it shows.
Remplacer l'adresse par sa destination F: Replace the address with its FINAL destination, the one the redirect points to.
L'agent connaît cette destination : elle: The agent knows this destination: it is measured during the crawl, so there is nothing to guess.
`curl -I` sur chaque ressource : la prem: `curl -I` on each resource: the first response must be a 200.
Les liens de la page passent par une red: The page's links go through a redirect before reaching their destination. A redirect is for visitors coming from elsewhere; inside the site, it only adds a hop and dilutes the link's signal.
Faire pointer chaque lien interne direct: Point each internal link directly to the final URL.
Relancer un crawl : aucun lien interne n: Run a new crawl: no internal link should appear in this family anymore.
Une URL du site contient une double barr: A URL on the site contains a double slash (`/blog//article`). The server often serves it anyway, but search engines see a DIFFERENT address from the clean version: two URLs for one page, and the signal is split between them.
Corriger le lien à la source — c'est pre: Fix the link at the source — it is almost always a concatenation where one segment already carries its trailing slash.
Relancer un crawl : la variante à double: Run a new crawl: the double-slash variant should no longer be discovered.
Des images n'ont pas d'attribut `alt`. I: Some images have no `alt` attribute. It serves first the people who browse with a screen reader, and secondarily search engines, which only have this text to know what the image shows.
Décrire ce que l'image APPORTE à la page: Describe what the image BRINGS to the page, in a short sentence.
Une image purement décorative prend un `: A purely decorative image takes an EMPTY `alt` (`alt=""`): this is the correct way to tell the screen reader to ignore it.
Relancer un crawl : plus aucune image sa: Run a new crawl: no more images without an `alt` attribute on the targeted pages.
La page déclare plusieurs fois la même b: The page declares the same tag several times. Search engines keep only one, and nothing guarantees it is the one you wanted: you are letting them choose for you.
Ne garder qu'une seule occurrence, celle: Keep a single occurrence, the one that really describes the page.
Chercher la cause : le plus souvent un g: Find the cause: most often a shared template that already sets the tag, which the page then sets again.
Afficher le source de la page servie : u: View the source of the served page: a single occurrence of the tag.
Le sitemap propose aux moteurs une page: The sitemap offers search engines a page that then forbids them to index it. The two signals contradict each other: you ask for a page to be crawled that you refuse to see indexed.
Trancher : soit la page mérite d'être in: Decide: either the page deserves to be indexed and the `noindex` goes, or it does not and it leaves the sitemap.
Dans le doute, la sortir du sitemap : c': When in doubt, remove it from the sitemap: it is the reversible option of the two.
Relancer un crawl : aucune URL du sitema: Run a new crawl: no sitemap URL should carry a `noindex`.
Sans balise `viewport`, un mobile affich: Without a `viewport` tag, a mobile phone displays the page like a shrunken desktop screen: tiny text, zooming required. Google indexes the mobile version first, so that is the version it judges.
Ajouter `<meta name=\"viewport\" content: Add `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">` to the `<head>`, ideally in the shared template.
Ouvrir la page sur un mobile ou en mode: Open the page on a phone or in responsive mode: the text must be readable without zooming.
Votre `robots.txt` interdit à des robots: Your `robots.txt` forbids AI SEARCH bots from reading these pages. These bots do not collect a corpus: they fetch a page to answer someone's question, and cite their source. Blocking them means disappearing from those answers — and their visits.
Ouvrir les agents de recherche : `OAI-Se: Open up the search agents: `OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `PerplexityBot`, `Perplexity-User`, `Claude-User`. A `Disallow: /` on any of them is enough to cut citation.
Vérifier qu'aucune règle large — un `Dis: Check that no broad rule — a `Disallow: /` under `User-agent: *` — catches them by ricochet.
Décider de l'ENTRAÎNEMENT séparément : b: Decide on TRAINING separately: blocking `GPTBot` or `CCBot` is a legitimate choice, with no effect on search. The two decisions are independent.
Relancer un crawl : ces pages ne doivent: Run a new crawl: these pages should no longer appear in the family.
Contrôler la règle appliquée agent par a: Check the rule applied agent by agent, not just `User-agent: *`.
Ces pages mettent trop longtemps à répon: These pages take too long to respond for an AI crawler. These agents do NOT run JavaScript and wait less than a browser: what a visitor finds merely slow, they give up on. The measurement covers the time until the complete HTML, without rendering — their exact point of view.
Mesurer d'abord le temps SERVEUR seul. A: First measure SERVER time alone. Above 600 ms, the cause is the hosting or the database, and nothing in the page will fix it.
Servir un HTML déjà complet : ces agents: Serve already-complete HTML: these agents will never see what JavaScript adds afterwards.
Mettre en cache les pages qui ne changen: Cache the pages that do not change on every visit.
Comparer avant/après sur les MÊMES URL :: Compare before/after on the SAME URLs: this family is judged on a measured difference, never on an impression.
Ces pages se ressemblent beaucoup — mesu: These pages are very similar — measured on their text, by comparing word sequences. Near-identical pages compete with each other: search engines pick one and ignore the others. Note: the “AI-generated” nature is NOT measured here, for lack of a classifier; only similarity is, among long article-format pages.
Décider pour chaque groupe : fusionner e: Decide for each group: merge into one authoritative page, or give each a genuinely different angle.
Si les pages doivent coexister (variante: If the pages must coexist (local variants, for example), declare a canonical to the one that serves as the reference.
Un plan identique rempli par des synonym: An identical outline filled with synonyms is still identical content in a search engine's eyes.
Relancer un crawl : les pages fusionnées: Run a new crawl: the merged or differentiated pages should leave this family.
Votre `robots.txt` autorise certains rob: Your `robots.txt` allows some training bots and blocks others. This is not a mistake in itself — it is one only if it is unintended, which is the most common case: a rule copied from a template, an agent added one day and the next ones forgotten. In practice, one publisher learns from your content and its competitor cannot.
Issue détectée: {label}. Elle peut impac: Issue detected: {label}. It may affect SEO/UX depending on the context.
Choisir une position et l'appliquer à to: Choose a position and apply it to all: open everything, or close everything.
Si le mélange est délibéré — un partenar: If the mix is deliberate — a partnership, a license — write it as a comment in the file, so the next person who opens it does not “fix” it.
Ne pas confondre avec les robots de RECH: Do not confuse this with SEARCH bots: closing them costs visits, closing training costs none.
Relire `robots.txt` agent par agent et v: Reread `robots.txt` agent by agent and check that the list matches the decision made, not its history.
Ouvrir l’issue, identifier les pages imp: Open the issue, identify the affected pages and the root cause (template, content, server config).
Appliquer une correction systémique (évi: Apply a systemic fix (avoid “case by case” fixes if it is a pattern).
Relancer un crawl pour confirmer la bais: Run a new crawl to confirm the counter goes down.
Une de ces redirections forme une boucle: One of these redirects forms a loop: the URL never reaches a page, so it is unreachable for Google.
{0} de ces redirections forment une bouc: {0} of these redirects form a loop: the URL never reaches a page, so it is unreachable for Google.
Ouvrir `https://{domain}/robots.txt` : l: Open `https://{domain}/robots.txt`: the response must be 200, in text/plain, and the Search Console tester must show no errors.
